subject: sounds
title: Take a sound away
about: Hear a word, drop one sound and tap what is left: snap without /s/ is nap, cart without /t/ is car. Deleting a sound means holding every sound of the word in mind (NC RF.1.3.d, segmenting) and is the phoneme skill that best predicts spelling; NC lists no separate sub-code for deletion, so it sits under RF.1.3.
tip: Have him say the word slowly with one finger up per sound, fold the deleted finger down, and say what is left.

cards.q: Say snap without the /s/. What word is left?
cards.sayQ: Say snap without the sss. What word is left?
cards.note: snap. Take away the sss: nap.
